title: The NSF Mark and the Travel Pouch
lessons: The player notices the NSF Certified for Sport mark and asks what that certification actually tells them about AG1.
The player is packing for a flight and still has single-serving AG1 travel packs from the welcome kit.

text: The player notices the NSF Certified for Sport mark and asks what that certification actually tells them about AG1.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: What does that NSF mark actually buy you?

entry-first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Certified for Sport screens for more than 280 banned substances. Competitive athletes care about that a lot.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: I am not a competitive athlete.

entry-first-4.speaker: AG1
text: Then it may matter less to you. It is still outside testing.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: Does it prove the benefits?

entry-first-6.speaker: AG1
text: No. Different question. The seal tells you what they tested me for, not that every claim I make is settled.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like that someone outside the brand is checking the product.
I care about proof, but I want to know which question each proof actually answers.
I am not an athlete, so this certification does not change much for me.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then the outside check matters to you for exactly what it is, not as a magic seal.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Good. A certification should not get credit for answering a question it never tested.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: Fair. If banned-substance screening is not relevant to your life, it may not move your decision.
The player is packing for a flight and still has single-serving AG1 travel packs from the welcome kit.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Three packets. That is all you get for this trip.

entry-return-2.speaker: AG1
text: I made the side pocket. That is why the welcome kit has single servings.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Mostly I just want one familiar thing tomorrow morning.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like having something familiar when I travel.
I am mostly taking these because they came with the kit.
I am leaving them here. One day without you is fine.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then take them. This is exactly the kind of boring continuity I am good at.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Free is still a reason. You do not have to make the relationship more romantic than it is.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: Leave them home.

return-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You are taking this well.

return-3-2.speaker: AG1
text: You will survive airport breakfast.
